Name: CUTSCENE_TIMEZONE_CONVERT_PARAM_ST
Description: Converts in-game time zones to the time of day used during cutscene playback. Each row gives the start hour of a time zone and the hour a cutscene uses while in that zone.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the NT version or mark the ones to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the product version or mark the items to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Time Zone Start Hour
Fields.Description: Start time of the time zone that is converted to a cutscene time. In hours (5.75 = 5:45).

Fields.Name: Cutscene Hour
Fields.Description: Time of day used while a cutscene plays in this time zone. In hours.
